scope: Selected communications/reminder index definitions, validity and readiness only. No business rows, query plans, mutations, RPC, DDL or history/platform changes.

indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX customer_communications_pkey ON shop_manager.customer_communications USING btree (id)
CREATE INDEX customer_reminders_customer_idx ON shop_manager.customer_reminders USING btree (customer_id)
CREATE INDEX customer_reminders_due_idx ON shop_manager.customer_reminders USING btree (due_date) WHERE (status = 'pending'::text)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX customer_reminders_pkey ON shop_manager.customer_reminders USING btree (id)
